# Embassy v1.8.2 — restarts owe you nothing now

The v1.8.1 drill exposed the last standing member of the stale-route family: a persisted Claude selection restored on boot was missing its controller state-root context, so the first delivery after any broker restart failed `CLAUDE_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE` until a manual `select-claude`. Thirteen source lines fix it — the restored selection now carries its construction context — and per-operation attestation is untouched: every delivery still freshly proves the exact session UUID, workspace, and root before any byte is written, and drift still fails closed.

With this patch, the promise reads clean end to end: restart the App Server, the Desktop app, the broker, or all three, in any order — the next message just delivers.

Upgrade: `npm install -g agent-embassy@1.8.2`, restart your broker (and enjoy that this is the last time a restart instruction carries a caveat).
